subject: architecture-layer3-asisecurity-enforce

metrics.name: ASISecurity.ai — The Enforce Layer
metrics.role: Enforces AGISafe decisions — sandboxing, permissions, approvals, revocation
enforcement_capabilities: Sandbox enforcement — restrict model execution environments
Permission gating — approve/revoke API access, model deployment
Approval workflows — human-in-the-loop for high-risk decisions
Revocation — pull deployed models, terminate agent sessions
Incident response — Article 73 broadcaster (EU AI Act, DORA, NIS2, GDPR)
metrics.hf_integration: Hugging Face scanner: CSOAI measures → AGISafe decides green/amber/red → ASISecurity enforces deployment gates on open models

honest_sentence: ASISecurity.ai is the enforce layer: sandboxing, permissions, approvals, revocation. Enforcement always backed by AGISafe decisions backed by CSOAI measurements — the full accountability chain.
